subject.title: [Feature]: Add interactive poll creation to Feishu via Card Kit

question: Should the official Feishu plugin own a fully supported interactive-poll contract, including persistent vote state and Card Kit callback setup, or should this remain an external/community Feishu extension?
rationale: The request adds a stateful user-facing channel capability and may require app-configuration guidance plus a durable storage and callback-security contract; those choices cannot be safely inferred from the existing disabled capability flag.

options.title: Sponsor official Feishu polls
options.body: Define the poll lifecycle, persistence, callback authorization, and supported Feishu app setup, then accept a focused Feishu-plugin implementation.

options.title: Keep it external
options.body: Direct the capability to a community Feishu plugin if maintainers do not want the official package to own interactive poll state and support.

recommendation.title: Sponsor official Feishu polls
recommendation.body: Define the poll lifecycle, persistence, callback authorization, and supported Feishu app setup, then accept a focused Feishu-plugin implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature is specific to the official Feishu package and its existing Card Kit and callback boundary.
